param.name: teamcity_aws_secretsmanager_query
param.description: The query to access the secret. It should be written in the `secretNameOrArn!/jsonKey` format. Without the `!/jsonKey` part the whole secret string is used.

param.name: teamcity_aws_secretsmanager_connectionId
param.description: The ID of the TeamCity AWS connection that should be used to access this secret

example.description: Adds a new parameter `env.DB_PASSWORD` that will fetch the value of the JSON key `password` from the secret `prod/db`, using the AWS connection `AwsProd`.
Adds a new parameter `apiToken` that will fetch the whole secret string of the secret referenced by its ARN.
